answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit. Each submission hangs on the oasis of a task receipt, and the relic is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. By the bridge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
